sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels panicked and flustered, with a burst of frustrated disbelief at being late on the very first day and a strong urge to fix it immediately.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: Why did the train have to stall today of all days?!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and frustrated, with a panicked sense of bad luck because her already shaky first-day start has been thrown off by something beyond her control.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s abruptly startled and confused, her panic briefly interrupted by the sight of the trembling figure as she tries to make sense of what she’s seeing.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She shifts from frantic self-focused stress to immediate, open concern, sounding gently worried and ready to help the crying child.
sprite_sequence.label: sadness

sprite_sequence.text: Whoa, seriously? Don't move, okay? I'm here.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She shifts instantly from frantic impatience to protective concern, feeling urgent and sympathetic as she tries to steady the crying boy and take charge.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: ...Ah, man. Fine. First day and I'm already doomed.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels frustrated and resigned about being late, but her concern for the crying boy is overriding her own panic, leaving her flustered yet determined to help.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s pushing past her frustration and lateness to focus on the frightened boy, sounding brisk and caring while trying to take charge of the situation.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: Okay, Kota. I'm Aoi. We're going to find your mom together.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a quick shift from frustrated panic to determined, reassuring protectiveness, choosing to take charge and help the boy despite being worried about being late.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: Did you come from the station? The bakery? Somewhere with lots of people?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is focused and reassuring, with her earlier panic pushed aside by a practical, protective urgency as she tries to calmly narrow down where the boy came from.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: Got it. Flower shop. Come on, hold my sleeve tight.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels focused and protective, pushing aside her own panic about being late so she can take charge and keep the frightened boy close.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: Excuse me! Did anyone see a woman looking for a little kid in a yellow cap?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is focused and urgent, pushing aside her own panic about being late to sound clear and helpful while actively trying to take charge of the situation.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: It's okay. He stayed near the crossing. He was really trying to be brave.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels relieved and quietly proud, softening into warm reassurance as she downplays the danger and praises the boy’s courage.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.text: Next time, don't chase buses, okay? They're not that interesting.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s relieved and quietly proud after helping them reunite, and she covers her lingering concern with a light, teasing joke to keep the mood cheerful.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.text: Oh, wow. I am absolutely dead.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a mix of exasperated panic and resigned self-mockery about being late, but underneath it she’s still energized and relieved from helping the boy.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels breathless, a little resigned about being late, but warmly satisfied and quietly proud that helping Kota was the right choice.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

gpt.rationale: Aoi should be visibly expressive and upbeat, but the scene overuses fear on nearly every urgent, caring, determined, and rueful line, flattening her emotions despite a few fitting surprise/happy beats.

claude.rationale: An extroverted character who 'laughs openly' and has a face that 'moves with her mood' should display bright grins and visible emotional shifts, but fear dominates 10+ consecutive lines during a compassionate rescue, and happiness only appears at the very end despite Aoi's outgoing, expressive nature being evident in her dialogue throughout.
